status: unpublished feasibility fixtures; not production APIs or support claims
purpose: Prove private systemd scope, sandbox display, native confirmed text, file dialogs and application receipts before defining a release contract

sources.use: Reviewed exported seat ABI declarations; libweston/desktop API and official output capture
StartTransientUnit arguments, tracking scope identity and real JobRemoved completion
Shipped daemon and GTK input module; a commit-only fixture implements the standard engine interface
Unmodified official portal with GTK synchronous post-processing properties; fixture-only build, original source digests in build_ibus_portal_probe.py
Review synchronous and asynchronous event completion; neither passed sustained native focus/Enter ordering

unproven_release_requirements: All package, desktop and toolkit combinations in the approved acceptance matrix
One production launch planner and supervisor with authoritative sandbox ownership
Production shared scheduler, real window/process/context admission, cancellation, stale callbacks and reconnect isolation across all adapters
Reliable native text-input protocol completion or explicit unsupported admission; do not claim direct v3 sequencing from serial alone
Authenticated reconnectable frame and input API with complete window and popup lifecycle
Private portal document grants, concurrent sessions and sandbox-accessible paths
Pinned production component catalog, complete native architecture qualification and release validation

observed_prototypes.case: strict Snap Firefox on Ubuntu 24.04 amd64
observed_prototypes.result: private real systemd scope, pure Wayland first frame, actual click, 64 repeated Unicode commits, a 14000-byte commit, ordered Enter, official remote file chooser and exact saved bytes; no security policy changes
observed_prototypes.limits: Multi-widget focus ordering, target revocation and production admission remain unproven; prototype supervisor status is now separately qualified

rejected_assumptions: text-input-v3 done serial is not a widget-processing acknowledgement; direct text/pointer/text crossed GTK fields
An IBus engine marker receipt alone does not prove Qt has applied text; both synchronous and asynchronous Qt IBus failed without poll-delay masking
IBus hybrid mode 2 nested dispatch can reorder GTK input under pressure; it is not the synchronous post-processing contract
Newer sandbox libxkbcommon rejects keycodes above 0xfff; fixture private markers use 2048..2079 and disable repetition
Flatpak 1.14 does not expose a relocated private document mount at the path returned by GetMountPoint; a bounded facade to the official headless host document service is prototyped
